payload.title: Improve automatic podcast audio synchronization precision for future edits
payload.description: Prior episode4 correction was a per-project173.33ms adjustment. Diagnose generic sync precision and implement measured refinement without a fixed episode-specific offset. Preserve all-source synchronization and current project edits.
acceptance: Improve generic automatic sync using measured signal evidence, not a hardcoded episode4 correction.
Verify offset sign, subframe accuracy, unreliable audio handling and multiparty synchronization.
Test real episode4 source audio and deploy verified local production without changing the finished episode.
